title: WAITING STATUS READS CLEARLY
why: Critic round 1 could not read the waiting state as screen UI. Keep the ordered small waiting-only line, with larger type and a clear bottom margin. Watch: waiting must remain a live view, never a continue or rejoin prompt.
now: The waiting status uses at least 32px text at 1080p in a 64px-high panel, with 64px clear of the bottom edge. Normal raid HUD and controls stay as ordered.
